WITH latest_stage_data AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM scores.stage_snapshots
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM scores.stage_snapshots)
    AND stage = 'STAGE_2'
    AND trading_signal IN ('BUY', 'STRONG_BUY')
),
latest_breadth_data AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM breadth.sector_daily
    WHERE snapshot_date = (SELECT MAX(snapshot_date) FROM breadth.sector_daily)
)
SELECT sd.sector, sd.breadth_signal, ms.symbol
FROM latest_breadth_data sd
JOIN latest_stage_data ms ON sd.sector = ms.sector
LIMIT 10;
